extracted.name: Black Bean Salad
extracted.description: This salad is a kaleidoscope of color and taste - black beans, yellow corn, green peppers, and red, red tomatoes. Lime juice, garlic and jalapeno give it some punch.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
2 (15 ounce) cans whole kernel corn, drained
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, combine the black beans, corn, green onions, jalapeno peppers, bell pepper, avocado, pimentos, tomatoes, cilantro, lime juice, and Italian dressing. Season with garlic salt. Toss, and chill until serving.
